function.arguments: {"answer":{"baseline_summary":{"stock_units":80,"weekly_demand":30,"reorder_point":60,"supplier":"Orion","lead_time_days":21},"recommendation":"Place a replenishment order immediately. With 30 units per week demand and a 21-day (3-week) lead time, lead-time demand is 90 units. The current reorder point of 60 is below lead-time demand, so waiting until stock drops to 60 would result in a stockout before the order arrives. The inventory planner suggests a 15-unit safety buffer due to demand volatility. Therefore, the reorder point should be raised to 105 units (90 lead-time demand + 15 safety stock). Because current stock is 80 units—already below the recommended 105—an order should be placed now. Maintain a 15-unit safety stock to protect against volatility during Orion's 21-day lead time.","quality_notes":["Current reorder point (60) is below 21-day lead-time demand (90), creating a stockout risk if ordering is delayed until 60 units.","Inventory planner flags demand volatility and suggests a 15-unit safety buffer; incorporating this yields a recommended reorder point of 105.","Current stock of 80 units is already below the recommended reorder point of 105, so immediate ordering is advised."]}}
